item.title: CRLF Email Header Injection in Plunk via Raw MIME Construction (CVE-2026-34975)
item.description:

Affected Target

Field Value

Language / Platform Python PoC against a Node.js/TypeScript email service
Authentication Required Yes (valid API user)
Network Access Required Yes (HTTP to Plunk API)

Summary

Plunk’s POST /v1/send endpoint builds a raw MIME email message by interpolating user-supplied fields (from.name, subject, custom headers, attachment filenames) directly into a template string without sanitizing CRLF (\r\n) sequences. An authenticated API user can inject arbitrary email headers — including a Bcc header — to silently redirect copies of outgoing email to an attacker-controlled address.
